_note: Per-slug overrides for the gallery classifier. The classifier trips on machines shot on a light or white studio background - a real problem for the modular line, semiconductor and cooling-fan pages, where every source image is a photograph of a whole machine but gets filed as 'workpiece' because there is a lot of white in the frame. Listing an image basename here forces its kind to 'machine' and gives it a primary rank so it can win hero selection.
_removals: Images listed under 'remove' are filtered out of images.json at build time. Use for images that show third-party branding, that we do not have the rights to display, or that we have decided are unfit for public use. Sources stay in _media so the decision is reversible.

remove._scaraNote: The single SCARA image in the source is a Mitsubishi Electric branded robot arm - a supplier's product photograph. Removed from the public site per the brand-mention rule; the page carries only text until we have a photograph of our own robotic cell.
remove._sixAxisNote: Both source images are third-party branded robot arms - Mitsubishi Electric (gallery-02) and Fanuc (gallery-01). Removed for the same reason.
